fusions.name: Morsel Snatch
fusions.desc: Snatches at the first enemy within 5 tiles with your tongue for 4 damage. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A gulp that deals 24 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding their remaining damage to the blow. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Burn the Tail Fat
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%. The heal has a 10% chance to crit.

fusions.name: Fed and Warm
fusions.desc: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
